Research transparency makes the full research process visible and verifiable: how a study was designed, how data were collected and analyzed, and how findings can be reproduced. Open science practices strengthen the credibility of research and let others build on it.

## What You Will Find Here

## Getting Started

**Preparing to share your research?** Read [Understanding Research Transparency](understanding-transparency.qmd) for the principles, then follow [Data Publication Preparation](publication-preparation.qmd) and the [Dataverse how-to guide](how-to-publish-dataverse.qmd) when you are ready to publish.
